about: A row of unlit quads (graph math, textures, colour spaces: should match to the pixel) over a row of lit spheres (one sun, no ambient), the same materials authored in Godot and in Unreal and imported into kin. Coordinates: metres, +y up, the camera looking down -z (Godot's and kin's; Unreal's: X = -z, Y = x, Z = y, in cm).

materials.TexTint: unlit: checker.png (sRGB) at uv x 3, times the colour parameter Tint (linear 0.8, 0.5, 0.25)
materials.DataMask: unlit: remap(mask.png's R (linear data), 0..1 to 0.2..0.8) as grey, times (1, 1 - mask G, 1)
materials.Bumps: lit: base (0.6, 0.6, 0.6), roughness 0.4, normal.png (OpenGL convention) at uv x 4
materials.Rim: lit: base (0.05, 0.1, 0.3), roughness 0.6, emission fresnel(power 3) x (1, 0.5, 0.1)
